title: OpenSim Ultrasonography Pipeline — Bilateral Upper Extremity Trunk (BUET) Model
description: Automated Python pipeline for multi-patient biomechanical analysis of sonographers using OpenSim. This release integrates the Bilateral Upper Extremity Trunk (BUET) model for direct-use (no re-scaling) computation of Inverse Dynamics (ID), Static Optimization (SO), and Joint Reaction Analysis (JRA) on both shoulders, elbows, and wrists simultaneously. Results are compiled into a JAMOVI-ready master dataset CSV. Designed for occupational biomechanics research on musculoskeletal loading in ultrasonography scanning tasks.
notes: This version (v2.0.0) replaces the Lai-Uhlrich lower-body model with the Bilateral Upper Extremity Trunk (BUET) model. Key changes: (1) No re-scaling — BUET model used as-is; (2) Lumbar coordinate renaming (lumbar_extension→flex_extension etc.) via new mot_adapter module; (3) JRA now active as a full pipeline step for bilateral glenohumeral, elbow, radioulnar, and wrist joints; (4) Bilateral muscle group configuration (deltoid, rotator cuff, elbow flexors/extensors, pronators, lumbar erectors, latissimus dorsi); (5) Dynamic cohort-median validation replaces hardcoded thesis medians.
